name: Belvaac
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:weapon)Aptly dubbed "Double Bladed Axe", Belvaac is a dense short double-bladed axe Teigu landing devastating blows. It can split in two and be thrown to track opponents staying in range. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and prefers the very strong.
